brief:
An Israeli airstrike struck a tuk-tuk in Beit Lahiya, killing one person and wounding five others, according to Al Jazeera English. The strike marked the first Israeli aerial bombardment in the northern Gaza enclave in a week, resuming air operations after a pause in airstrikes.

The incident occurred as conditions in Gaza remain volatile following prolonged conflict between Israeli forces and armed groups operating across the territory. Northern Gaza has faced sustained military pressure in recent months, with civilian infrastructure and transport frequently targeted during operations.
dek: Strike on a tuk-tuk in Beit Lahiya kills one, wounds five in first Israeli aerial bombardment in a week.
title: Israeli airstrike kills one in northern Gaza
